title: A4=57 geometry, exact mesh neighborhood, one-photon falsifier, literal rank-48 tensor, Monster gate, and three chained constructions
result: The 57 support graph is exactly T(10) disjoint union 2T(4); the one-parameter MacWilliams family gives only t<=245 and does not prove global A4 extremality. All 630 single transpositions of the 36-port order were replayed exactly: none beats 398 rotations, 22 tie it, and all have depth 69. A length-slope/intercept one-photon experiment separates mode-dependent device latency from propagation. The rank-48 algebra is closed twice: 178 nonzero products in split Wedderburn matrix-unit coordinates and a literal 48-relation orbital tensor containing 904 nonzero intersection constants, tensor SHA-256 a17a375552c102d281e3ba79b602b67aa54a426fd68b1878293763ea65395ff9. The Monster gate remains fail-closed. Three constructions separate direct-sum capacity, tensor-product factors, serial speed limits, time-bandwidth packing, and self-similar address density while preserving invariant vacuum c.
